description: I am interested in game development, particularly in creating engaging games with creative concepts.
summary:
Space is vast and boundless, holding countless wonders and mysteries waiting to be discovered, each revealing the hidden magic within every planet and every moon.
This interactive 3D educational game brings together a collection of NASA spacecraft and robots that have played a vital role in uncovering the universe's secrets and revealing remarkable truths about the cosmos. Though their missions have come to an end and they have been forgotten in the vastness of space, the knowledge they brought us will never be forgotten.
details: The primary mission of our project is to creatively spread knowledge about NASA spacecraft that have completed their missions. Its core benefit lies in bringing these forgotten and overlooked spacecraft back to life by telling their stories and making their legacies unforgettable. We hope this project serves anyone interested in learning simplified, accessible facts about these historic missions. To build this experience, we utilized several supporting applications listed in our references, with Godot Engine 4.7 as our primary development tool and GDScript 2.0 as the programming language. The creative essence of the project lies in its overarching narrative and the individual stories of each spacecraft. Finally, our key considerations throughout development were presenting scientific information in an engaging, visually appealing way while ensuring the game remains completely free of programming bugs.
